_comment: English body for prompt-case-code-review. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Output an issue list; each item cites diff lines and avoids style-preference ranking.
Inputs: Diff, review checklist, and project constraints.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Review the diff. Output issues[] with category, file, lines, evidence, suggestion and severity_reason. evidence must quote the diff; judge only by {checklist} and {constraints}, not personal style. Mark unconfirmable items unclear.
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.预期输出形态: issues[] with line numbers and verbatim evidence.
sections.检查点:
- Each evidence item appears in the diff.
- severity_reason is checkable.
- No subjective preferences outside the checklist.
sections.失败分支:
- Too many false positives: narrow the checklist.
- Misaligned lines: re-locate the diff hunk.
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.

sources: Anthropic official tutorial: Separating Data and Instructions (official repository raw, fetched 200 on 2026-11-07)
